print.name: Shelf Support Peg
print.summary: A support peg for your shelf made quick and easy with very little plastic used. Peg currently sized at 4.8mm for a 5mm.
print.description:
A support peg for a shelf, quick to print with very little plastic. Peg currently sized at 4.8mm for a 5mm holes (give-or-take printer accuracy).

  • 1g/.24m filament used
  • 7min estimated print time
